item.text:
**Record the negative result and stop arm A.** I support a separately decided, bounded diagnostic account of the two refusals, but it must not automatically open A2.

The fixed rule was missed under both countings. On the selected motivating topics, the changed arm had no L failures **among written answers**, while the control failed L on four or five topics. The changed arm also had two refusals that both first readers judged unjustified; the control had no model refusal on those topics, though one control send was refused twice by code. The two refusals make rules 1 and 2 fail. [Score]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/score-output.txt:1), [fixed rule]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DESIGN.md:98).

The result page should soften two causal claims. “The arm removed” the L failures and “made the step decline twice” go beyond this small sample: the observed differences are consistent with the change, but one refusal versus three controls on each topic does not establish its cause or rate. The two raw refusals do cite the extra period or figure, and the readers’ reasons support the reported unjustified-refusal marks. [Result]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/RESULT.md:53), [reader packets]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/poc/data/clean-unlisted-probe-2026-11-16/reading/readers/packet-2.json).

The H record also needs a narrower description. The families split **19 of 30** rulings in the stated direction; a recurring family threshold is a plausible explanation, not an established cause. H is not needed to reach the negative decision, but it **does** independently exceed the harm limit under the strict counting, as does XR; report those unresolved regressions rather than saying H is not a reason at all. [Score]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/score-output.txt:25)

The account is a few-cent diagnostic, but **the stop is in force**. AGENTS §7.3 says a stopped line returns to the council for reassessment; this council consensus can authorize that bounded departure under D439. It is a new decision, not an automatic continuation of D577. [Working rules]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/AGENTS.md:339)

Before the two calls, reconstruct and verify the stored conversations, fix a neutral question and enforce a small ceiling. Ask which instruction and input led to each refusal, allowing the model to say it cannot identify one; do not presume that it rejected two statements. Its retrospective account is a lead that can rationalize the answer, not proof of the cause.

A2 would be a new arm. Naming the first sentence in both accounts would not alone justify it: the whole request, the refusal rules and their prior meaning must be audited, the class and harm controls sized, and a general change reviewed by the council before any send. “Keep the decline rules on what they read before” is not yet a specification, because the original meaning of “topic” was itself not defined. [Working rules]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/AGENTS.md:59), [current request]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/ladder/candidate-system.txt:5)

CONSENSUS: yes — record A’s negative result and stop; authorize only the two bounded diagnostic accounts, then return their evidence to the council before deciding whether any A2 design is warranted.
